data.title: 洛茜 · 礁石滩脚踏冲浪板比出胜利手势的灿烂欢呼
data.action: 单脚踩在斜插在沙滩上的黄黑相间冲浪板上，一手搭在板端，另一手高高举起比出胜利的V字手势
data.location: 塔卫二外海巨浪冲刷的黑色页岩冲浪海岸
data.lighting: 强烈的双日高空日光直射在泛着水光的冲浪板与防晒泳衣上，高对比度明艳夏日运动感
data.camera: full shot, low angle, wide lens, thrilling extreme sports composition, dynamic sunny vibe
data.mood: 充满干劲、朝气蓬勃与无所畏惧的拓荒者豪情
data.description: 刚刚征服了高达三米的异星巨浪。洛茜浑身湿淋淋地拖着冲浪板走上黑沙滩，拉链半开的潜水服衬托出充满活力的健美体魄，护目镜推在棕色短发上笑得肆无忌惮。她踩着冲浪板朝管理员用力挥动手臂，阳光晒得她健康的皮肤泛起麦色光晕——「哈！管理员，看见刚才那一波漂亮的浪头了吗！塔卫二的巨浪比模拟舱刺激一万倍！再休息十分钟，下一趟冲浪比赛，你可千万别落后啊！」
promptTokens: lemon yellow and black sporty wetsuit
data.promptProse: Rossy from Arknights: Endfield rests her foot boldly against a colorful surfboard on black sands in her yellow-and-black zip wetsuit, throwing a triumphant peace sign with an infectious, sun-drenched grin. Brilliant Mediterranean midday sunlight bounces off the azure water surface, casting bright dancing caustic ripples across her athletic swimwear.
data.animaCaption: Pounding alien surf rumbles behind her as the spirited Endfield scout celebrates riding the wildest breakers. Brilliant Mediterranean midday sunlight bounces off the azure water surface, casting bright dancing caustic ripples across her athletic swimwear.
